notes.title: 💋 The New Bored Wife Update Is Live! 💋
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/318461336c5ee0d8d3d5c8c839ce2a855f1f1a4f.jpg"]

She’s back — with a brand-new update that brings more story, more spice, and a major visual upgrade 🔥



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/159f0fe0b90ed41816d4bd226b238d90b35b7f85.jpg"]

We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to deliver our biggest update yet, and it’s finally ready for you to enjoy. Whether you’re here for the plot (👀) or the steamy scenes, this release has something you’ll love.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/b611deeb1fa5edada58d0b86c0b66de179fd6678.jpg"]

🆕 What’s New:

✨ 500+ new renders — with updated lighting and sharper detail

🎞️ 15 brand-new animations — smoother, hotter, and more expressive

🏆 5 new achievements — unlock them all

🎙️ Voice acting — bringing key scenes to life

🎵 Background music — setting the tone for every moment

🛠️ Visual overhaul — thanks to a reworked rendering pipeline, the whole game looks better than ever



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/495e330d7b80699b5967ae5d174ced3f1ec4555c.jpg"]

We’ve taken a big step forward with how Bored Wife looks and feels. The new rendering system took time to implement, but the result is a richer, more polished experience across the board.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/f7e6ceb859fc6cab87ace8c62f73eaf9770bda7e.jpg"]

This update is about more than just visuals — it’s about pushing the story forward and deepening the emotional (and physical 😏) journey of our characters.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45052130/6d3e15d1185de2ffa630727410d9b721340c0c00.gif"]

We truly hope you enjoy this release — and as always, thank you for playing and supporting Bored Wife! 💖

notes.title: 💋 Upcoming Update — Coming Very Soon! 💋
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A brand new Bored Wife update is just around the corner — and it’s our biggest one yet! 🔥

Here’s what’s coming in the next release:

✨ 500+ new renders

🎞️ 15 fresh animations

🏆 5 new achievements

🎙️ Voice acting

🎵 Background music

🛠️ Improved visual quality thanks to a reworked rendering pipeline

We’ve poured a ton of effort into this update — more story, more heat, and an even better visual experience. We can’t wait for you to see it!

Stay tuned — it’s almost here 💖

Thank you for playing and supporting Bored Wife!

notes.title: Approaching the Release of "Bored Wife"!
notes.notes:

We are excited to announce that work on "Bored Wife" is actively progressing, and we are getting closer to the release! We plan to launch the game in the coming months.

Additionally, we have prepared several pin-ups featuring Mrs. Moore that will delight all fans of the game. Don’t miss the chance to enjoy these unique images!
